description.en: colorEffect changes colors, distortionEffect positions, and layerEffect can read neighboring pixels.

code:
.colorEffect(shader, isEnabled: enabled)
.distortionEffect(wave, maxSampleOffset: CGSize(width: 0, height: 18), isEnabled: enabled)
.layerEffect(glow, maxSampleOffset: CGSize(width: 12, height: 12), isEnabled: enabled)
